subtitle: Sovereign Constitution Root-of-Trust, Capture Detection, and Recovery Extension

new_primitives.GENESIS_CONSTITUTION_ROOT: Externally attested root binding constitution version, sovereign implementation/profile and verifier profile.
new_primitives.CONSTITUTION_CHECKPOINT: Versioned constitutional state chained to an admitted predecessor.
new_primitives.SOVEREIGN_MEASUREMENT: Identity/hash/profile of the judicial implementation or declarative rule-set.
new_primitives.CONSTITUTION_RECOVERY_RECEIPT: Evidence of rollback/recovery to the last independently attested constitutional checkpoint.

core_rule: A sovereign cannot internally prove the integrity of the constitution that defines that sovereign when constitution, sovereign and verifier may share one compromise boundary.
anti_self_certification: LOCAL_CONSTITUTION_PASS does not establish integrity without independent root binding.
failure_ceiling: If no independent pre-compromise constitutional checkpoint survives, authenticated constitutional continuity is NOT_ESTABLISHED rather than guessed.
verification_requirements: modify local sovereign and verifier consistently
canonical_lines: A captured judge can be perfectly consistent with a captured law.
The constitution that defines the sovereign requires an independent root of trust.
When every constitutional root is lost, Janus must admit uncertainty rather than manufacture continuity.
